_comment: Cards that exist only for the draw-doubling test (tests/unit/test_draw_doubling.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_draw_doubler` is Thought Reflection's shape -- every draw its controller makes becomes two. `t_bard_doubler` is Bard, King of Dale's and Alhammarret's Archive's -- the same, except the first card drawn in each of its controller's draw steps. Enchantments with no other text, so nothing but the replacement is on the board.

cards.name: Test Draw Doubler
cards.oracle_text: If you would draw a card, draw two cards instead.

abilities.text: If you would draw a card, draw two cards instead.

cards.name: Test Draw-Step Draw Doubler
cards.oracle_text: If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.

abilities.text: If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.
